parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
administrator[ædminəstreitər]n.
An administrator is a person who controls a business, company, or organization.
→ Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to do.
2
affluent[æflu:ənt]adj.
If someone is affluent, they are wealthy.
→ People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.
3
audit[ɔ:dit]v.
To audit means to inspect financial records from a person or business.
→ The government usually audits companies that report lower than usual incomes.
4
automate[ɔ:təmeit]v.
To automate a company means to install machines or computers to do the work.
→ When the bank automated, it started installing ATM machines.
5
bribe[braib]v.
To bribe someone means to illegally persuade them for a favor with money.
→ The judge was bribed so that she would set the suspect free.
6
corrupt[kərʌpt]adj.
If someone is corrupt, they break the law for money or fame.
→ The corrupt policemen didn’t arrest the man because he gave them money.
7
dispose[dispouz]v.
To dispose of something means to get rid of it.
→ He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.
8
headquarters[hedkwɔ:rtərz]n.
A headquarters is a building where the bosses of a company work.
→ He drove the long route to headquarters because it was a nice day.
9
incentive[insentiv]n.
An incentive is what makes a person want to do something.
→ The chance of winning a prize was incentive to get people to play the game.
10
infrastructure[infrəstrʌktʃər]n.
An infrastructure is a collection of services needed to run a society or business.
→ Power lines are important parts of a city’s infrastructure.
11
legislate[ledʒisleit]v.
To legislate means to make laws.
→ Senators have to legislate fairly, so most people will enjoy the benefits.
12
legitimate[lidʒitəmit]adj.
If something is legitimate, then it is acceptable according to the law.
→ She found a legitimate plan to raise extra funds for her vacation.
13
manipulate[mənipjəleit]v.
To manipulate something means to skillfully or unfairly control or affect it.
→ The Dr. manipulated the data to make it look like the cure was working.
14
merchandise[mə:rtʃəndaiz]n.
Merchandise is goods ready to be purchased or sold.
→ The store added more merchandise because there were more shoppers.
15
retail[ri:teil]n.
Retail is the activity of selling goods to the public, often for personal use.
→ Though cheap to make, once a t-shirt reaches retail, it costs ten times as much.
16
revenue[revənu:]n.
Revenue is the income made by a company.
→ The new products really increased the business’s monthly revenue.
17
rubbish[rʌbiʃ]n.
Rubbish is trash or waste.
→ The floor around the garbage can was covered with all kinds of rubbish.
18
subsidy[sʌbsidi]n.
A subsidy is money given by the government to companies to assist them.
→ The official gave the company a subsidy, so it could open two new factories.
19
transaction[trænsækʃən]n.
A transaction is an act of buying or selling something.
→ Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.
20
violate[vaiəleit]v.
To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.
→ I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated the speed limit.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: merchandise
questions.explanation: merchandise (hàng hóa) tương đương với goods.

questions.content: corrupt
questions.explanation: corrupt (tham nhũng, đồi bại) mang nghĩa xấu (bad).

questions.content: rubbish
questions.explanation: rubbish (rác rưởi) tương đương với trash.

questions.content: transaction
questions.explanation: transaction (giao dịch) tương đương với sale (việc bán hàng).

questions.content: revenue
questions.explanation: revenue (doanh thu) tương đương với income (thu nhập).

questions.content: manipulate
questions.explanation: manipulate (thao túng, điều khiển) tương đương với control.

questions.content: infrastructure
questions.explanation: infrastructure (cơ sở hạ tầng) bao gồm đường sá (roads).

questions.content: headquarters
questions.explanation: headquarters (trụ sở chính) tương đương với base.

questions.content: audit
questions.explanation: audit (kiểm toán, kiểm tra) tương đương với inspect.

questions.content: incentive
questions.explanation: incentive (khuyến khích, động lực) tương đương với reason (lý do để làm gì đó).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: This is the affluent area of the city. It is where most of the poor people live.
questions.explanation: affluent (giàu có). Khu vực giàu có không thể là nơi hầu hết người nghèo sống. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: He added his trash to the large pile of rubbish.
questions.explanation: rubbish (rác thải). Thêm rác vào đống rác lớn là sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: The company automated by hiring twenty new workers.
questions.explanation: automate (tự động hóa). Tự động hóa là dùng máy móc, không phải thuê thêm công nhân. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: This painting is an important part of the city’s infrastructure.
questions.explanation: infrastructure (cơ sở hạ tầng). Bức tranh không phải là cơ sở hạ tầng. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: The subsidy helped the company recover some of the money it had lost.
questions.explanation: subsidy (tiền trợ cấp). Tiền trợ cấp giúp công ty phục hồi số tiền đã mất là sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: The store sold most of its merchandise in the sale over the weekend.
questions.explanation: merchandise (hàng hóa). Cửa hàng bán phần lớn hàng hóa của mình là đúng.

questions.content: The cook violated the two sauces together into one delicious sauce.
questions.explanation: violate (vi phạm). Trộn hai loại nước sốt không dùng từ vi phạm. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: She took the food out of the refrigerator and then disposed the door.
questions.explanation: dispose (vứt bỏ). Cô ấy không thể vứt bỏ cánh cửa tủ lạnh sau khi lấy thức ăn. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: The company’s bank records were audited.
questions.explanation: audit (kiểm toán). Hồ sơ ngân hàng của công ty được kiểm toán là sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: Bigger kids sometimes find it easy to manipulate smaller children.
questions.explanation: manipulate (thao túng). Trẻ lớn đôi khi dễ dàng thao túng trẻ nhỏ là sử dụng đúng.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: violate
questions.explanation: violate (vi phạm) trái nghĩa với respect (tôn trọng, tuân thủ).

questions.content: affluent
questions.explanation: affluent (giàu có) trái nghĩa với poor (nghèo).

questions.content: dispose
questions.explanation: dispose (vứt bỏ) trái nghĩa với keep (giữ lại).

questions.content: administrator
questions.explanation: administrator (người quản lý) trái nghĩa với worker (công nhân).

questions.content: legitimate
questions.explanation: legitimate (hợp pháp, đúng đắn) trái nghĩa với wrong (sai trái).

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
Getting to play with her friends was something to make her want to clean her room. [ 26 ]

The act of selling something took place right before the shop closed. [ 27 ]

By the end of the meeting, they had made into law the repair of the highways. [ 28 ]

She illegally persuaded the guard, so he would let her into the secret meeting. [ 29 ]

It was a good year for the banks, but it was a bad year for places that sell things to the public. [ 30 ]

The person who controls the company is a very efficient manager. [ 31 ]

The papers that she needed were at the building where the bosses worked. [ 32 ]

The law-breaking company was stealing money from many of its investors. [ 33 ]

Shawn is working for a law-following organization in a bad part of town. [ 34 ]

The money made by our company was even better than last year’s. [ 35 ]
questions.explanation: something to make her want (điều khiến cô ấy muốn) tương đương incentive (động lực).
act of selling something (hành động bán cái gì đó) tương đương transaction.
made into law (đưa vào luật) tương đương legislated.
illegally persuaded (thuyết phục bất hợp pháp bằng tiền) tương đương bribed.
places that sell things to the public (nơi bán hàng cho công chúng) tương đương retail.
person who controls the company (người điều hành công ty) tương đương administrator.
building where the bosses worked tương đương headquarters.
law-breaking (phạm luật, đồi bại) tương đương corrupt.
law-following (tuân thủ luật pháp) tương đương legitimate.
money made by our company (tiền công ty kiếm được) tương đương revenue.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Corrupt Administrator

Mr. Pig was an administrator at a big factory that made different kinds of merchandise. During a meeting at the company’s headquarters, his bosses said they wanted the factory to make more money.

“If the factory makes more money, then you will too,” his boss, Mr. Horse, told him. It was a great incentive. Pig had always wanted to be as affluent as his bosses.

Mr. Pig returned to the factory and started making changes. However, most were not very nice, and some were not legitimate.

First, he fired all his employees. Then he automated the entire factory. Machines now made everything, and the other animals, Mr. Rabbit, Mr. Sheep, and Mr. Dog had no jobs. Next, he bribed some corrupt senators into legislating special subsidies for the factory. Finally, instead of paying a company to dispose of the factory’s rubbish properly, he violated the law by throwing it into the river to save money.

At first, all the changes to the factory’s infrastructure created more revenue. But soon many stores could no longer sell the factory’s goods at retail. It seemed that the machines couldn’t make products as well as the workers. The customers were disappointed with the factory’s merchandise.

There were other problems, too. The animals had told their friends and family to stop buying the factory’s goods. Officials discovered the factory’s rubbish in the river, and when they audited the company, they discovered that Pig had manipulated the law in order to get more money.

All transactions with Pig’s factory stopped. The factory lost money, and Pig lost his job. He realized his mistakes too late. He had tried to become rich by saving money any way possible, but the cheapest way was not always the best.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True (T) or False (F).

questions.content: Mr. Rabbit was an administrator at a big factory that made different kinds of merchandise.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Theo đoạn 1, "Mr. Pig was an administrator at a big factory..." (Ông Lợn mới là người quản lý tại nhà máy lớn).

questions.content: Some of the changes made to the factory were legitimate.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Ở đoạn 3 có ghi: "However, most were not very nice, and some were not legitimate." (Tuy nhiên, hầu hết các thay đổi đều không tốt và một số không hợp pháp). Câu hỏi nói "Some of the changes... were legitimate" là trái với thông tin trong bài.

questions.content: Mr. Pig bribed some corrupt senators into legislating special subsidies for his factory.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Trong đoạn 4, "Next, he bribed some corrupt senators into legislating special subsidies for the factory." (Tiếp theo, ông ta hối lộ một số thượng nghị sĩ tham nhũng để ban hành các khoản trợ cấp đặc biệt cho nhà máy).

questions.content: Mr. Pig violated the law by disposing of the factory’s rubbish in the ocean.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Cuối đoạn 4 có viết: "...he violated the law by throwing it into the river to save money." (ông ta đã vi phạm luật bằng cách ném rác xuống sông để tiết kiệm tiền). Rác bị ném xuống sông (river), không phải đại dương (ocean).

questions.content: At first, changes to the factory’s infrastructure created less revenue.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Ở đầu đoạn 5 có ghi: "At first, all the changes to the factory’s infrastructure created more revenue." (Lúc đầu, tất cả những thay đổi đối với cơ sở hạ tầng của nhà máy đã tạo ra nhiều doanh thu hơn).

questions.content: During their meeting at headquarters, what incentive did Mr. Pig’s affluent boss give him?
options: His boss told him, 'If the factory makes more money, then you will too.'
His boss gave him a new car
His boss told him he could take a vacation
His boss gave him a raise
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 2, sếp của ông ta nói: "If the factory makes more money, then you will too... It was a great incentive." (Nếu nhà máy kiếm được nhiều tiền hơn, thì anh cũng vậy... Đó là một động lực tuyệt vời).

questions.content: What happened to the other animals after Pig automated his factory?
options: After Pig automated his factory, the other animals had no jobs.
They got better tools to work
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 4, sau khi tự động hóa toàn bộ nhà máy: "Machines now made everything, and the other animals... had no jobs." (Bây giờ máy móc làm mọi thứ, và các động vật khác... không còn việc làm).

questions.content: According to the officials who audited Pig’s factory, why did he manipulate the law?
options: According to the officials, Pig manipulated the law in order to get more money.
Pig manipulated the law to help the animals
Pig manipulated the law to build a new factory
Pig manipulated the law by mistake
questions.explanation: Ở cuối đoạn 6, "...when they audited the company, they discovered that Pig had manipulated the law in order to get more money." (...khi họ kiểm toán công ty, họ phát hiện ra rằng Lợn đã thao túng luật pháp để kiếm thêm tiền).

questions.content: What happened to Mr. Pig and his factory when all transactions stopped?
options: When all transactions stopped, the factory lost money, and Pig lost his job.
Pig was sent to another country
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn cuối: "All transactions with Pig’s factory stopped. The factory lost money, and Pig lost his job." (Mọi giao dịch với nhà máy của Lợn đều dừng lại. Nhà máy bị mất tiền và Lợn mất việc).

questions.content: Why could the stores no longer sell goods at retail?
options: Because the machines didn't make products as well as the workers, and customers were disappointed.
Because they ran out of materials.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 5, "It seemed that the machines couldn’t make products as well as the workers. The customers were disappointed with the factory’s merchandise." (Dường như máy móc không thể làm ra sản phẩm tốt như con người. Khách hàng đã thất vọng với hàng hóa của nhà máy).
